name: after-effects-mcp-pro
description: After Effects MCP Pro: MCP server that lets Claude drive Adobe After Effects through the Claude Bridge CEP panel.
author: Mohammad Malkawi

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=dist/server/index.js --loader:.md=text --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/server/package.json','{\"type\":\"module\"}');require('fs').copyFileSync('manifest.json','dist/manifest.json')"
scripts.test: node test/e2e.mjs dist/server/index.js && node test/panel.cjs ../panel/main.js && node test/host.cjs ../panel/host/host.jsx
scripts.pack: npm run build && mcpb pack dist after-effects-mcp-pro.mcpb
